title: pvStreamTracer
body:
## pvStreamTracer

Integrates steady streamlines through one time step of a 3-component vector field, forward, backward or both, from seeds made by the built-in SeedType generator (Point Cloud, the ParaView default, or Line). The output is polydata polylines carrying the input point arrays interpolated along each line, IntegrationTime, and cell arrays SeedIds and ReasonForTermination (1 left the domain, 4 maximum length, 5 maximum steps, 6 below terminal speed); with ComputeVorticity on (ParaView default) Vorticity, Rotation, AngularVelocity and Normals are added. Use the curated streamTracer for the common case, pvStreamTracerWithCustomSource to seed from another node's points, and pvStreakLine or pvTemporalParticlesToPathlines for unsteady flow.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Step lengths default to Cell Length units (fractions of a cell), not dataset lengths; set IntegrationStepUnit to Length before giving steps in metres.
- MaximumStreamlineLength has a static default of 1.0 that ParaView may replace with the input size; set it explicitly, or long streamlines can be cut short in large domains.
- Cell-centred velocity is accepted, but vorticity is then 0; convert with cellToPoint first when vorticity or smooth interpolation matters.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `StreamTracer`. Identity: `filters/StreamTracer`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Stream Tracer filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array with 3 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeVorticity` | Specify whether to compute vorticity. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `InitialStepLength` | This property specifies the initial integration step size. For non-adaptive integrators (Runge-Kutta 2 and Runge-Kutta 4), it is fixed (always equal to this initial value) throughout the integration. For an adaptive integrator (Runge-Kutta 4-5), the actual step size varies such that the numerical error is less than a specified threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `IntegrationDirection` | This property determines in which direction(s) a streamline is generated. | `{"type":"enum","values":["FORWARD","BACKWARD","BOTH"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"FORWARD"` |
| `IntegrationStepUnit` | This property specifies the unit for Minimum/Initial/Maximum integration step size. The Length unit refers to the arc length that a particle travels/advects within a single step. The Cell Length unit represents the step size as a number of cells. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Length","Cell Length"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Length"` |
| `IntegratorType` | This property determines which integrator (with increasing accuracy) to use for creating streamlines. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Runge-Kutta 2","Runge-Kutta 4","Runge-Kutta 4-5"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Runge-Kutta 2"` |
| `InterpolatorType` | This property determines which interpolator to use for evaluating the velocity vector field. The first is faster though the second is more robust in locating cells during streamline integration. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Interpolator with Point Locator","Interpolator with Cell Locator"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Interpolator with Point Locator"` |
| `MaximumError` | This property specifies the maximum error (for Runge-Kutta 4-5) tolerated throughout streamline integration. The Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator tries to adjust the step size such that the estimated error is less than this threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumStepLength` | When using the Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator, this property specifies the maximum integration step size. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumSteps` | This property specifies the maximum number of steps, beyond which streamline integration is terminated. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumStreamlineLength` | This property specifies the maximum streamline length (i.e., physical arc length), beyond which line integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MinimumStepLength` | When using the Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator, this property specifies the minimum integration step size. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SeedType` | The value of this property determines how the seeds for the streamlines will be generated. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Line","Point Cloud"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Line"}` |
| `SurfaceStreamlines` | Specify whether to compute surface streamlines. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TerminalSpeed` | This property specifies the terminal speed, below which particle advection/integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `UseLocalSeedSource` | If true the filter considers that the whole seed source is available on all ranks. Else the filter will aggregate all seed sources from all ranks and merge their points. WARNING: do not set this value to true unless you know what you're doing. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Vectors` | This property contains the name of the vector array from which to generate streamlines. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Nested `SeedType` → `Line`

Syntax: `{"type":"Line","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `extended_sources/HighResLineSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SeedType.options.Point1` | Start point [x, y, z] of the line, in the input’s coordinates; the first seed or sample point lies exactly here. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `SeedType.options.Point2` | End point [x, y, z] of the line, in the input’s coordinates; the last seed or sample point lies exactly here. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `SeedType.options.Resolution` | Number of equal segments the seed line is divided into; the line has Resolution + 1 points and each one seeds a streamline, so this sets how many streamlines are traced. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Nested `SeedType` → `Point Cloud`

Syntax: `{"type":"Point Cloud","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `extended_sources/PointSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SeedType.options.Center` | Centre [x, y, z] of the spherical region in which the random seeds are placed, in the input’s coordinates. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `SeedType.options.NumberOfPoints` | Number of random seed points, and hence of streamlines started (per integration direction). | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SeedType.options.Radius` | Radius of the spherical seed region around Center; seeds fill its volume uniformly. 0 places every seed at Center. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvStreamTracer",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
